court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Yogesh vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and Another — Respondents

facts_of_case: The appellant, Yogesh, filed an appeal to quash the order dated 4th April, 2018 in Special Sessions Trial No. 30 of 2018. The case arose out of Case Crime No.163 of 2013, under Sections 363, 366 and 376 I.P.C. and Sections 3 (2) (v) of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities), Act, 1989.

legal_principles.principle: The benefit of doubt always goes in favour of the accused.
legal_principles.held: However, the benefit of such difference always goes in favour of the accused.

legal_principles.principle: The prosecution must prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.
legal_principles.held: No case for the alleged offence is made out against the appellant.
